With unchanged owner/text/source, one otherwise valid selection is lost depending on completion order. Comments at2920-2921 and Add Another Photo/Add More Images labels support retaining successive page additions; they do not establish a required ordering policy for concurrent batches. Existing stale-context rejection is an intentional safety boundary and must remain effective.
